destination.title: Supergravity constructions, reductions, dualities and solutions
destination.question: How do supersymmetry, matter couplings and duality organize supergravity theories, their dimensional realizations and solution sectors, and what additional conditions restrict particular realizations?
destination.summary: No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical memberships, so their rationale cannot be independently certified. The descriptions support this proposed navigational family across dimensions and supersymmetry counts. Intrinsic construction, algebraic uplift compatibility, realized consistent truncation and quantum completion remain separate questions.

systems: Extended and matter-coupled supergravities in the dimensions specified by each source
Ten- and eleven-dimensional parent theories and lower-dimensional reductions
Conditional exotic six-dimensional theories and unified Maxwell–Einstein theories
targets: Gaugings, matter couplings and action formulations
Effective reductions, consistent truncations and uplift restrictions
Classical solutions, supersymmetry, stability and charges
Specified quantum-consistency tests and alternative realizations
regimes: Classical, low-energy and perturbatively corrected regimes remain source-specific
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work is included
AdS, Minkowski and domain-wall settings are not interchangeable
assumptions: Existence of interacting non-metric theories is conditional where stated
Algebraically allowed truncations need not have a realized internal geometry
conventions: Retain source-specific supersymmetry notation, vector counting and electric-frame restrictions
Distinguish symmetries of actions from symmetries of equations and Bianchi identities
includes: Different systems and methods linked by explicit construction or comparison questions
Adjacent access to BMS charges, string-vacuum connectivity and amplitude methods
excludes: A universal five-dimensional N=2 scope for the numerical selection
Identification of local supersymmetry with quantum-gravity consistency
Identification of effective reduction, algebraic compatibility and consistent truncation
Canonical question equivalence inferred from numerical proximity

sources.title: Dimensional Reduction of the Heterotic String over nearly-Kaehler manifolds

evidence.text: What four-dimensional bosonic effective action and N=1 supergravity data result from reducing ten-dimensional heterotic supergravity–Yang-Mills on homogeneous non-symmetric cosets admitting nearly-Kähler structures?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: How are scalar and vector couplings organized after supersymmetric circle reduction from six to five dimensions?

sources.title: Embedding the SU(3) sector of SO(8) supergravity in $D=11$

evidence.text: How can the complete dynamical bosonic SU(3)-invariant sector of electric SO(8)-gauged four-dimensional maximal supergravity be embedded consistently in eleven dimensions, and does it yield an additional truncation to minimal N=2 gauged supergravity?

sources.title: Consistent Kaluza-Klein Truncations and Two-Dimensional Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reduction of E9 exceptional field theory determine the scalar potential of upliftable two-dimensional maximal gauged supergravities and constructively establish the SO(9) sphere truncation?

sources.title: Maximal D = 2 supergravities from higher dimensions

evidence.text: How can the complete bosonic dynamics, especially the scalar potential, be constructed for maximal gauged D=2 supergravities admitting consistent geometric uplifts to ten or eleven dimensions?

sources.title: Supersymmetric domain walls in maximal 6D gauged supergravity III

evidence.text: Which consistent six-dimensional maximal gaugings arise from the R+×SO(4,4) decomposition of the embedding tensor, and which half-supersymmetric domain walls can be constructed in selected invariant scalar sectors?

sources.title: Modave lecture notes: Introduction to Exceptional Field Theory

evidence.text: How can exceptional hidden symmetries organize the full equations of maximal supergravity, and how does this reformulation support consistent truncations and KK mass calculations?

sources.title: All couplings of minimal six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Construct the complete low-energy coupling of six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity to tensor, vector and charged hypermultiplets, including anomalous interactions, abelian kinetic mixing and a Lorentz-covariant treatment of chiral tensors.

sources.title: Supergravities: From fields to branes

evidence.text: How is eleven-dimensional supergravity constructed by deforming a free supersymmetric theory, and how can its toroidally reduced bosonic matter equations acquire a universal self-duality form, with possible quantum and gravitational extensions?

sources.title: Unified Maxwell-Einstein and Yang-Mills-Einstein supergravity theories in five-dimensions

evidence.text: Do five-dimensional N=2 unified Maxwell-Einstein supergravities exist beyond homogeneous scalar manifolds, and which admit a simple gauge group acting on every vector, including the graviphoton?

sources.title: M-theory and gauged supergravities

evidence.text: How do dimensional reductions produce gauged maximal supergravities with string/M-theory origins, when do their consistent field equations admit actions, and how are their supersymmetric domain walls related to higher-dimensional branes?

sources.title: Unified N=2 Maxwell-Einstein and Yang-Mills-Einstein supergravity theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional N=2 Maxwell–Einstein supergravity theories obtained from known five-dimensional theories admit a simple Lagrangian symmetry acting irreducibly on every electric vector, including the graviphoton, and which permit unified Yang–Mills gaugings?

sources.title: N=2 supergravity and N=2 superYang-Mills theory on general scalar manifolds: Symplectic covariance, gaugings and the momentum map

evidence.text: How can general matter-coupled N=2 supergravity, its isometry gaugings and scalar potential be formulated geometrically without requiring special coordinates or a holomorphic prepotential, and how does the rigid theory emerge?

sources.title: New vacua of gauged N=8 supergravity in five-dimensions

evidence.text: Which critical points occur in a particular SU(2)-invariant sector of five-dimensional gauged N=8 supergravity, and what supersymmetry, stability, central charges and ten-dimensional interpretations do their proposed conformal phases have?

sources.title: Chiral Supergravity

evidence.text: Can chiral gravity be extended supersymmetrically, with explicit gravitino modes and conserved charges demonstrating chirality and perturbative AdS3 stability under suitable boundary conditions?

sources.title: A landscape of non-supersymmetric AdS vacua on coset manifolds

evidence.text: Can sourceless nonsupersymmetric type IIA AdS4 vacua be constructed by retaining the geometry of supersymmetric SU(3)-structure solutions while changing their fluxes, and which examples survive tests of left-invariant scalar fluctuations?

sources.title: More on Massive 3D Supergravity

evidence.text: Can cosmological NMG and GMG arise as genuine bosonic truncations of N = 1 supergravity, which AdS vacua are supersymmetric, and under what conditions are their linearized excitations perturbatively unitary?

sources.title: Wrapped Brane Solutions in Romans $F(4)$ Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Which lower-dimensional supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS fixed points arise from wrapped D4-branes in Romans F(4) supergravity, which UV-to-IR flows reach them, and what stability or singularity tests do they satisfy?

sources.title: Open strings in type IIB AdS$_{3}$ flux vacua

evidence.text: Do dynamical D5-brane open strings destabilise previously found nonsupersymmetric type IIB AdS3 vacua, generate additional stable vacua, or alter their proposed scale separation?

sources.title: Deforming AdS3×S3×T4AdS3×S3×T4 in Type IIB Supergravity

evidence.text: Can Type IIB backgrounds WAdS3 × WS3 × T4 preserve supersymmetry with independent warpings of the two curved factors, and which such backgrounds arise as near-horizon limits of regular brane-and-flux configurations that are asymptotically locally flat?

sources.title: AdS in warped space-times

evidence.text: How can semi-localised brane intersections generate AdS factors whose warp factors depend only on internal coordinates, providing candidate AdS/CFT backgrounds and lower-dimensional gauged-supergravity embeddings?

sources.title: M theory / heterotic duality: A Kaluza-Klein perspective

evidence.text: How much of conjectured M-theory/heterotic duality can be exhibited through classical Kaluza–Klein reductions, including scalar cosets, field couplings, charge lattices and Yang–Mills-supported branes?

sources.title: Dimensional Reduction of the Heterotic String over nearly-Kaehler manifolds

evidence.text: Expand the metric and B-field in invariant tensors/forms, integrate internal Hodge contractions, and dualize the four-dimensional two-form to an axion. Nonclosed invariant two-forms generate bi dωi terms. Scalar redefinitions make radius limits transparent while preserving kinetic normalization.

sources.title: Chiral Supergravity

evidence.text: Expand g = ḡ + λh + λ²j + … and ψ = λψ(1) + λ²ψ(2) + …. Bosonic and fermionic equations decouple at linear order because their torsional coupling begins at second order.

sources.title: A landscape of non-supersymmetric AdS vacua on coset manifolds

evidence.text: Scalar spectra are extracted from the four-dimensional potential of the consistent left-invariant N=2 truncation. The authors use N=1 superpotential and Kähler-potential technology for the retained scalars, accounting separately for the additional axion omitted by that description.

sources.title: More on Massive 3D Supergravity

evidence.text: Superconformal tensor calculus combines rigid supersymmetry with local conformal invariance. A scalar compensator multiplet is gauge fixed to obtain the relevant bosonic curvature and S-dependent terms, without executing the complete fermionic conformal construction.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Bound the norm of dK, apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the path velocity, and integrate its total variation. The operation avoids geodesic solutions and supplies a lower bound for paths within the controlled metric region.

sources.title: Embedding the SU(3) sector of SO(8) supergravity in $D=11$

evidence.text: Use intrinsic coordinates adapted to Sasaki–Einstein or nearly-Kähler structures for subsectors and vacua. Check the minimal uplift with exterior-form identities and the D=4 Maxwell equations; organize vacuum four-form checks through common coefficient equations.

sources.title: On the supersymmetries of Anti-de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: How can the symmetry Lie superalgebras of supersymmetric AdS × X backgrounds be identified geometrically, including cases where explicit Killing spinors are unavailable?

sources.title: U duality as general coordinate transformations, and space-time geometry

evidence.text: Can the full Cremmer–Julia symmetries be generated from internal coordinate transformations in the eleven-dimensional and type IIB reduction pictures, intertwined by T-duality, and how does this explain duality identifications of torus geometry?

sources.title: Higher derivative supergravities in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: What higher-derivative supergravity invariants, construction methods, supersymmetry transformations, Killing-spinor solutions and duality constraints are known across 1≤D≤11?

sources.title: 6D Dyonic String With Active Hyperscalars

evidence.text: Determine necessary and sufficient Killing-spinor conditions for matter-coupled six-dimensional gauged supergravity, identify which field equations remain independent, and construct a supersymmetric dyonic string with active hyperscalars.

sources.title: Exploring 6D origins of 5D supergravities with Chern-Simons terms

evidence.text: Which necessary conditions allow a five-dimensional supergravity with eight or sixteen supercharges, Abelian vectors and ungauged scalars to arise as the low-energy circle reduction of an anomaly-free six-dimensional theory?

sources.title: Consistent truncations and dualities

evidence.text: Do generalised T-dualities and consistent truncations in generalised geometry correspond one-to-one? The paper establishes the direction from generalised cosets to consistent truncations and investigates what obstructs the converse.

sources.title: Exotic supergravities and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can exotic six-dimensional supergravities provide alternative UV completions of maximal five-dimensional supergravity while satisfying the no-global-symmetries conjecture, and which exotic spin-2 tensors evade the resulting compactification obstruction?

sources.title: 11D Supergravity and Hidden Symmetries

evidence.text: How do toroidal reductions of maximal eleven- and ten-dimensional supergravity acquire exceptional hidden symmetries, why is dualization essential, and how does exceptional field theory expose these structures before dimensional reduction?

sources.title: The higher-dimensional origin of five-dimensional $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Which five-dimensional N=2 matter contents, scalar manifolds and gaugings are algebraically compatible with consistent truncations of higher-dimensional supergravity?

sources.title: Compactification on Calabi-Yau threefolds: consistent truncation to pure supergravity

evidence.text: Can compactification on an arbitrary Calabi–Yau threefold yield an explicit consistent truncation to pure supergravity with eight supercharges, so that every lower-dimensional solution uplifts, including the full nonlinear fermionic theory?

sources.title: Flat deformations of type IIB S-folds

evidence.text: What group-theoretical mechanism makes axion-like S-fold deformations flat, how are they interpreted in five dimensions, and can it generate nonsupersymmetric deformations of the N = 4, SO(4)-symmetric S-fold that remain perturbatively stable in four-dimensional supergravity?

sources.title: <math display="inline"><mi>β</mi></math> Symmetry of Supergravity

evidence.text: Can the non-geometric part of toroidal O(d,d) symmetry be identified directly in the higher-dimensional supergravity action, constrain its couplings, and admit explicit first-order α′ corrections with an invariant action and closed transformation algebra?

sources.title: Higher derivative couplings with multi-tensor multiplets in 6D supergravity, action and anomalies

evidence.text: Construct a proper action for six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity with multiple tensor multiplets and gauge anomalies, and obtain the leading supersymmetric gravitational Green–Schwarz curvature-squared counterterm with matter couplings.

sources.title: An E(9) multiplet of BPS states

evidence.text: What spacetime interpretation do positive real E9 roots and higher E10 fields admit, and can Weyl transformations generate an infinite BPS multiplet and explain its generalized dual potentials?

sources.title: Higher-form symmetries in supergravity, scalar charges and black-hole thermodynamics

evidence.text: How do local/global symmetries, conserved currents, scalar charges and black-object thermodynamics of minimal five-dimensional supergravity relate to those of its circle reduction, the four-dimensional T3 model?

sources.title: On M-theory fourfold vacua with higher curvature terms

evidence.text: What metric and flux corrections solve eleven-dimensional supergravity on a compact eight-manifold when known higher-curvature terms are included, and what can modified Killing spinor equations establish about the corrected geometry and supersymmetry?

sources.title: Options for gauge groups in five-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which compact global symmetries can be gauged in five-dimensional N=2 supergravity, and what restrictions do local supersymmetry and physical kinetic terms impose on scalar geometry, vector fields and tensor representations?

sources.title: Trivector symmetry of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Can the non-geometric tri-vector generator of toroidally reduced supergravity be realized covariantly in eleven dimensions, and which dual fields are needed to extend its action from field strengths to potentials?

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: What shared lower-dimensional structure permits comparison of the four ten-dimensional theories? Toroidal reduction gives a common orthogonal scalar coset and generic Abelian gauge fields, allowing the paper to compare duality identifications and charged classical solutions.

sources.title: Unified non-metric (1, 0) tensor-Einstein supergravity theories and (4, 0) supergravity in six dimensions

evidence.text: Assuming an interacting six-dimensional non-metric (4,0) supergravity exists, what lower-supersymmetry truncations, unified tensor–Einstein theories, and exceptional-field-theory uplifts could reproduce five-dimensional unified Maxwell–Einstein supergravities?

sources.title: New couplings of six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity be coupled simultaneously to arbitrary numbers of tensor, vector and hypermultiplets, including gauging, and what singularities and anomaly constraints accompany these couplings?

sources.title: Dynamical equations from a first-order perturbative superspace formulation of 10D, N=1 string-corrected supergravity. (I)

evidence.text: Does the proposed first-order deformation of 10D, N=1 superspace yield bosonic equations admitting compatible component actions in both two-form and six-form formulations, and equivalence to the gravitational part of the existing anomaly-free component action?

sources.title: The Gauging of five-dimensional, N=2 Maxwell-Einstein supergravity theories coupled to tensor multiplets

evidence.text: Which gaugings of five-dimensional N=2 Maxwell–Einstein supergravity remain supersymmetric when charged spectator vectors become tensor multiplets, and what restrictions follow for scalar potentials, AdS vacua, gauge groups and tensor representations?

sources.title: Fiber bundles and generalized dimensional reduction

evidence.text: How do global symmetries enable consistent generalized reductions of eleven- and ten-dimensional supergravities, and what restrictions do global geometry and topology impose on the compactification and resulting masses?

sources.title: N=8 matter coupled AdS(3) supergravities

evidence.text: Which subgroups of SO(8,n) can be gauged while preserving D=3, N=8 local supersymmetry, and can a resulting SO(4) theory reproduce the symmetries and massless spectrum of six-dimensional (2,0) supergravity on AdS3×S3?

sources.title: On the string landscape without hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Is the universal hypermultiplet required by quantum gravity with eight supercharges, or can non-geometric constructions remove it? The paper also investigates connections to geometric phases, possible rank restrictions, and the possibility of pure 5d supergravity.

sources.title: Introductory Lectures on Extended Supergravities and Gaugings

evidence.text: How does gauging deform extended supergravity to introduce gauge interactions, fermion masses and a scalar potential while preserving local supersymmetry, and how does the embedding tensor organize dualities and flux compactifications?

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an endpoint wall preserve any supercharges compatible with its unbroken Poincaré symmetry? The answer depends on minimal lower-dimensional spinors and bulk chirality.

sources.title: N=2 extremal black holes

evidence.text: How do classical supersymmetric magnetic black holes in general N=2 supergravity evolve through vector-multiplet moduli space, and when can their space-time geometry be obtained explicitly from special Kähler geometry?

sources.title: Hitchin functionals in N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: How can type II supergravity on backgrounds admitting eight selected supercharges be organized in an N=2-like form, and how do intrinsic torsion and fluxes determine its geometry, prepotentials and possible four-dimensional truncations?

sources.title: Coupling of M-branes in M theory

evidence.text: How can eleven-dimensional supergravity and electrically charged membranes and dyonic five-branes be described as a closed dynamical system, and how can a duality-symmetric formulation yield a five-brane coupling involving only the standard three-form potential?

sources.title: Duality in N=1, D = 10 superspace and supergravity with tree level superstring corrections

evidence.text: How are the usual three-form and dual seven-form formulations of N=1, D=10 supergravity related after tree-level superstring corrections, and can the simpler dual equations yield a bosonic action?

sources.title: Tri-Sasakian consistent reduction

evidence.text: Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

sources.title: Duality orbits of non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: Which duality-inequivalent gauging orbits admit a geometric higher-dimensional origin, and can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reductions of double field theory realize genuinely non-geometric orbits?

sources.title: 8d supergravity, reconstruction of internal geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which gauge algebras can couple consistently to eight-dimensional supergravity with 16 supercharges? Total rank cannot distinguish 18 copies of su(2) from six copies of su(4), so the question requires restrictions sensitive to individual factors and their couplings.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: The low-energy vector sector of 5d N=1 supergravity is encoded by a cubic polynomial. The relevant data include both gauge Chern–Simons coefficients and mixed gauge/gravitational coefficients, with charged massive fields already removed from the generic Coulomb-branch description.

sources.title: Scalar masses in general N=2 gauged supergravity theories

evidence.text: At fixed gravitino mass and cosmological constant, does generic N=2 gauged supergravity impose a universal upper bound on the lightest scalar's squared mass, and how does the answer depend on matter content and the number of gauged isometries?

sources.title: Four-dimensional $\mathbf{\mathcal{N}=4}$ SYM theory and the swampland

evidence.text: The setting separates matter gauge rank from gravity-multiplet vectors in non-chiral Minkowski supergravity with 16 supercharges. This distinction is essential: the bound on r_G does not count the additional 10−d graviphotons.

sources.title: Survey of supergravities

evidence.text: Which supergravities, matter couplings and gaugings have been constructed across dimensions, and how can their component formulations and duality-covariant descriptions be summarized?

sources.title: On supersymmetric solutions of D = 4 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: How can bosonic solutions of minimal gauged N = 2 supergravity in four dimensions admitting a Killing spinor be characterized systematically, and which supersymmetry fractions and explicit geometries occur? The review also considers extending the construction to external matter sources.

sources.title: New F$^{4}$ invariants in five-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which four-derivative superinvariants remain independent after field redefinitions in five-dimensional N=2 supergravity with one or two vector multiplets, which are pure vector invariants, and do these modify static BPS black holes?

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent truncations around eleven-dimensional AdS₅ vacua preserving 16 supercharges yield five-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity with vector multiplets, and what restricts their matter content and gaugings?

sources.title: Lectures on Gauged Supergravity and Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can supergravity gaugings be constructed covariantly under the ungauged theory's duality group, and how do their deformation parameters encode geometric, p-form and non-geometric fluxes?

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers supersymmetric theory construction together with explicit modes, conserved charges, chirality and perturbative AdS3 stability.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 combines theory construction and action formulations with perturbative solution sectors, supersymmetry, stability and charges. It covers the supersymmetric extension and all requested tests while retaining the boundary-condition qualification.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers type IIA solution construction through flux changes and the explicitly restricted stability tests on those solutions.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 explicitly combines classical solution construction and stability. It covers the flux-deformed sourceless IIA backgrounds and their left-invariant scalar tests together. Reusing supersymmetric geometry does not establish supersymmetry of the new flux choice, and passing the stated test would not establish stability of omitted sectors.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers supergravity action and truncation construction, supersymmetric AdS vacua and the specified perturbative consistency test of linearized excitations.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 combines supergravity construction, truncations, solution sectors and additional conditions restricting realizations. The source's perturbative unitarity test remains a separate condition alongside genuine bosonic truncation and vacuum supersymmetry.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers Romans F(4) solution sectors, wrapped-brane dimensional realizations, UV-to-IR flows and their stated stability or singularity tests.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 covers fixed points, connecting solution flows and their source-specific stability or singularity restrictions in Romans F(4) supergravity. q18 establishes construction coverage but not the whole flow-and-test bundle; q5 cannot be assigned a specific spectrum test absent from the description.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers matter-coupled type IIB solution construction, stability and restrictions on the resulting dimensional realization, including the proposed scale hierarchy.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 combines matter-coupled construction, solution stability and conditions restricting dimensional realizations. It therefore accommodates all three open-sector tests. q5 alone lacks the new-vacuum and hierarchy targets; q18 covers construction and hierarchy but explicitly separates subsequent stability testing.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers supersymmetry of the specified type IIB solution family and its higher-dimensional brane-and-flux realization with stated boundary conditions.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 covers supersymmetry of the solution family and its dimensional realization together. Independent warpings, regularity and asymptotically locally flat boundary conditions are retained. q10's supersymmetric regime and regular-completion target do not independently establish the first, separate supersymmetry-classification target.

membershipSample.placementReason: Covers higher-dimensional brane-generated AdS solutions and their lower-dimensional gauged-supergravity realizations, retaining the candidate-background motivation.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 covers solution construction and lower-dimensional gauged-supergravity realization together. q10 explicitly includes semi-localized intersections, but its targets do not independently establish the additional embedding aim. Internal-only warp dependence is retained; candidate AdS/CFT use is not a demonstrated dual, and an embedding is not automatically a consistent truncation.

membershipSample.placementReason: Its combined reduction, duality, coupling and classical-solution scope covers all the stated classical M-theory/heterotic tests.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q20 combines reduction, duality, matter couplings and classical solution sectors. This covers scalar cosets, couplings, lattice comparisons and Yang–Mills-supported branes without turning classical evidence into quantum-duality proof.

destination.title: Inflationary attractors, predictions and validity
destination.question: What produces inflationary-attractor predictions, and how do dynamics, embedding assumptions, observations and reconstruction methods delimit their use?
destination.summary: The original numerical membership is useful for discovery but supplies no evidence of equivalence or universally shared premises. A geometric-universality core connects to angular dynamics, quintessential evolution, thermal dissipation, modified cosmologies and small-scale perturbativity. Reconstruction and scalar-tensor compatibility remain accessible adjacent questions.

systems: Two-field, quintessential and axionic hybrid α-attractor variants
Adjacent scalar reconstruction and scalar-tensor models
targets: Mechanisms and limits of robust primordial predictions
regimes: Contracting, bounce, inflationary, reheating and asymptotic dark-energy phases
assumptions: Each model retains its own field content, initial conditions and approximation hierarchy
Swampland inequalities are conditional filters only where explicitly adopted

sources.title: Alexei Starobinsky and Modern Cosmology

evidence.text: How do the historical versions of Starobinsky inflation relate to conformal, α-, and pole attractors, and what do the observational combinations discussed in this memorial review imply for their viability and possible generalizations?

sources.title: Alexei Starobinsky and Modern Cosmology

evidence.text: Use a Jordan-to-Einstein metric transformation followed by scalar-field redefinition to obtain canonical variables. The review emphasizes that completing the theory with matter requires tracking the induced matter–inflaton interactions.

sources.title: Alexei Starobinsky and Modern Cosmology

evidence.text: Illustrate potential flattening by allowing a sufficiently heavy scalar χ to track its instantaneous minimum in V(ϕ,χ)=ϕ²χ²+m²(χ−χ0)². The reviewed effective trajectory has V=m²χ0²ϕ²/(ϕ²+m²).

sources.title: Alexei Starobinsky and Modern Cosmology

evidence.text: Canonicalize kinetic poles and expand the resulting potential near its plateau. For T-models, ϕ=√(6α)tanh[φ/√(6α)]; the leading exponential coefficient can be absorbed into a field shift, explaining the asymptotic independence from many potential details.

sources.title: <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math>-attractor potentials in loop quantum cosmology

evidence.text: Can contracting-phase initial conditions predict the duration of inflation for α-attractor potentials in LQC, and can this duration together with cosmological observables constrain α and the Barbero–Immirzi parameter γ?

sources.title: Unity of Cosmological Inflation Attractors

evidence.text: What common kinetic structure explains robust inflationary predictions in α-attractors and models with nonminimal gravitational coupling, and can a class of ξ-attractors be made exactly equivalent to α-attractors?

sources.title: Warm hybrid axion inflation in α-attractor models constrained by ACT and future plan experiments

evidence.text: Can thermal dissipation in an axionic hybrid α-attractor model produce scalar tilt, tensor fraction, and running compatible with the observational combinations quoted by the paper, and how do linear and cubic temperature dependence change those predictions?

sources.title: Angular inflation in multi-field $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: When do two-field α-attractors develop a prolonged angular inflationary phase, and how does this phase change perturbations and observable predictions beyond radial universality?

sources.title: One-loop corrections to the E-type <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math>-attractor models of inflation and primordial black hole production

evidence.text: Do cubic-interaction one-loop corrections remain perturbatively small in generalized E-type α-attractor models producing primordial black holes, and can their induced gravitational-wave spectra support a conditional reconstruction of the inflationary potential?

sources.title: Non-minimal Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Does the inflationary attractor of conformally coupled models survive general negative nonminimal coupling ξ, and what explains the rapid convergence of scalar tilt and tensor predictions?

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Can inflation driven by a nonperiodic saxion near an infinite-distance boundary retain a valid effective description and exhibit α-attractor behavior?

sources.title: Superconformal Inflationary $\alpha$-Attractors

evidence.text: Can superconformal inflationary attractors be generalized by a parameter α with a geometric interpretation, producing continuous interpolation between chaotic inflation and universal large-N predictions?

sources.title: Constraining the quintessential <math display="inline" id="d1e2043" altimg="si18.svg"><mi mathvariant="bold-italic">α</mi></math>-attractor inflation through dynamical horizon exit method

evidence.text: Can dynamical horizon exit analysis constrain the inflationary parameters of a quintessential α-attractor while retaining a sufficiently small asymptotic dark-energy density?

sources.title: BICEP/Keck and cosmological attractors

evidence.text: Which inflationary models remain compatible with the 2021 BICEP/Keck constraints, and how do cosmological attractors accommodate small tensor amplitudes while supplying theoretically motivated B-mode targets?

sources.title: <math display="inline"><mi>α</mi></math>-attractor inflation: Models and predictions

evidence.text: What parameter constraints and primordial-observable predictions follow from numerical CMB fits of representative exponential and polynomial α-attractors when inflationary perturbations are evolved without slow-roll approximations and reheating uncertainty is included?

sources.title: Rapid-Turn Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Which hierarchies control the candidate attractor? Small inflationary and turn-rate variations permit an algebraic leading solution. The stated hierarchy omega squared much greater than epsilon also allows omega to approach zero, so it does not alone ensure uniform error constants.

sources.title: Inflation in Extra-Dimensions with one or two branes

evidence.text: Can monomial and simplest α-attractor inflation, with the inflaton confined to the SM brane, accommodate the paper's Planck/BICEP observations with or without ACT in DD, RS1 and RS2, subject to effective-theory bounds?

destination.title: De Sitter extrema, supersymmetry breaking and control in supergravity
destination.question: Which supergravity constructions permit positive-energy extrema, what determines their stability, and under which additional assumptions can they have a controlled string interpretation?
destination.summary: The original packet supplies candidate membership rather than an independently stated scientific region. Its useful common subject includes constructions, obstructions, unstable extrema, statistical metastability and consistency tests across different dimensions and supersymmetries. The original membership needs revision where shared formal tools connect sources with different physical targets.

String-motivated effective theories and classical flux/source supergravity
Rigid supersymmetry as a qualified comparison

Supersymmetry breaking, scalar spectra and construction mechanisms
Embedding, effective-theory control and conjectural consistency tests

Stable extrema, metastable extrema, saddles and parametrically shallow tachyons kept distinct

sources.title: On Fayet-Iliopoulos terms and de Sitter vacua in supergravity: Some easy pieces

evidence.text: When is a constant Fayet–Iliopoulos term genuine in supergravity, can genuine FI terms coexist with anomaly cancellation and classically stable de Sitter vacua without exact global symmetries, and how do FI terms behave under N=2 to N=1 truncation?

sources.title: Gauge R-symmetry and de Sitter vacua in supergravity and string theory

evidence.text: Can a minimal N=1 supergravity model with gauged shift/R-symmetry support metastable de Sitter vacua with vacuum energy independently tunable from supersymmetry breaking, and retain a tensor/linear-multiplet dual description with a superpotential?

sources.title: All gaugings and stable de Sitter in D = 7 half-maximal supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent deformations and duality orbits exist in seven-dimensional half-maximal supergravity with three vector multiplets, and can their scalar potentials support stable de Sitter critical points?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can supersymmetry-breaking branes and metastable de Sitter vacua be described in string-derived effective supergravity, and what do classical flux extrema imply for de Sitter swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Automorphic Structures of Heterotic Vacua

evidence.text: How does Sp(4,Z) target-space duality constrain moduli stabilization, threshold corrections, and the existence and stability of de Sitter extrema in heterotic-inspired effective supergravity with a Wilson line?

sources.title: De sitter vacua from N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can Abelian gauging of the quantum-corrected universal hypermultiplet produce a de Sitter saddle whose unstable direction connects two smooth supersymmetric vacua, avoiding a singular endpoint on either side?

sources.title: Effective supergravity descriptions of superstring cosmology

evidence.text: What possibilities and consistency restrictions do effective supergravities impose on de Sitter uplifting, especially in N=1 and N=2 theories, and how do superconformal methods clarify their structure?

sources.title: On Fayet-Iliopoulos terms and de Sitter vacua in supergravity: Some easy pieces

evidence.text: The examples are analyzed through F- and D-term scalar potentials, vacuum spectra and gauge-anomaly traces. The quoted cubic and gravitational traces include gravitino weights 3 and −21, respectively; possible Green–Schwarz contributions and mixed-gauge anomalies make the full conditions model dependent.

sources.title: Gauge R-symmetry and de Sitter vacua in supergravity and string theory

evidence.text: Solve V=0 and V′=0 for a Minkowski stationary point, then tune toward small positive energy. Compute the scalar and fermion spectrum with kinetic normalization and Goldstino elimination; the scalar mass is reported positive on the selected branch.

sources.title: All gaugings and stable de Sitter in D = 7 half-maximal supergravity

evidence.text: Evaluate critical-point spectra with the inverse scalar kinetic metric rather than the raw Hessian. Fermion shift matrices provide the supersymmetry conditions and an alternative expression for the scalar potential.

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Use constrained multiplets, especially X²=0, to package the Goldstino and other brane fields; superconformal supergravity and the new D-term provide supersymmetric completions.

sources.title: Automorphic Structures of Heterotic Vacua

evidence.text: Siegel modular covariance and stabilizer representations constrain zeros and gradients. The authors vectorize the bipartite transformation law into a Kronecker-product eigenvalue problem, requiring a common invariant vector for every stabilizer generator.

sources.title: De sitter vacua from N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Obtain Killing prepotentials from the quaternionic SU(2) connection, construct the superpotential and scalar potential, and analyze critical points and Hessians. Coordinates ρ=sinh(r)cos(θ), η=cosh(r)sin(θ) regularize the two BPS fixed points.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Can a classical de Sitter supergravity solution satisfy weak coupling, large physical lengths, flux quantization, and bounded orientifold availability simultaneously?

sources.title: De Sitter solutions in N=4 matter coupled supergravity

evidence.text: Which gaugings and SU(1,1) angles permit positive extrema of matter-coupled N=4 supergravity, and how are their scalar masses related to the extremal potential?

sources.title: Stable de Sitter vacua from N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: Can matter-coupled N=2 supergravity admit de Sitter extrema without tachyons, and could such models extend to higher supersymmetry or string theory?

sources.title: de Sitter Conjectures in $N$=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: Does the simplest flat-metric supergravity model of F-term supersymmetry breaking possess stable positive-energy extrema that conflict with the refined de Sitter conjecture?

sources.title: No metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplet matter admit locally stable vacua with spontaneously broken supersymmetry, particularly Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Analytic Classes of Metastable de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Under what conditions can string-motivated N = 1 supergravity yield analytic families of locally stable F-term de Sitter vacua, and how do their Minkowski limits and supersymmetry-breaking scales constrain construction methods?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in N = 8 supergravity and slow-roll conditions

evidence.text: Can electric/magnetic deformations of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity yield positive-energy critical points with arbitrarily small tachyonic mass-to-vacuum-energy ratios, overcoming the pattern of order-one instability in previously known examples?

sources.title: Simple metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can minimal N=2 gauged supergravity with one hypermultiplet and one vector multiplet admit metastable de Sitter vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms or non-Abelian gauging, and how does the answer depend on V/m_{3/2}²?

sources.title: Tachyonic de Sitter Solutions of 10d Type II Supergravities

evidence.text: Do de Sitter stationary points of ten-dimensional type IIB supergravity possess an unstable direction in the four scalars rho, tau, sigma_1 and sigma_2?

sources.title: New Fayet-Iliopoulos terms in $ \mathcal{N}=2 $ supergravity

evidence.text: Can new auxiliary-linear Fayet–Iliopoulos interactions produce stable de Sitter vacua in N=2 supergravity with one physical vector multiplet, without requiring R-symmetry gauging?

sources.title: Metastable spontaneous breaking of N=2 supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can rigid N=2 supersymmetry break spontaneously in metastable vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms, using only one hypermultiplet and one Abelian vector multiplet? What scalar-mass bounds follow, and what can be inferred about an extension to de Sitter supergravity?

sources.title: N=2 supergravity models with stable de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Which gauged N=2 supergravity models admit stable de Sitter vacua, and how do noncompact gauging, Fayet–Iliopoulos terms and relative symplectic rotations enable positive-potential critical points without tachyonic physical scalars?

sources.title: Weak gravity versus de Sitter

evidence.text: Does the magnetic weak gravity conjecture obstruct controlled de Sitter critical points in four-dimensional gauged N=2 supergravity, and does a singular Lagrangian gravitino mass matrix identify the obstruction?

sources.title: Stable de Sitter vacua in N = 2, D = 5 supergravity

evidence.text: Can five-dimensional N=2 gauged supergravity admit stable de Sitter vacua, and which combinations of scalar geometry, charged tensors, R-symmetry gauging and charged hypers permit them?

sources.title: Stable de Sitter Vacua in 4 Dimensional Supergravity Originating from 5 Dimensions

evidence.text: Under what symplectic-frame and gauge-contraction conditions can stable de Sitter families in five-dimensional N = 2 supergravity be related to four-dimensional de Sitter families, and how far does the construction extend beyond generic Jordan scalar manifolds?

sources.title: Potential and mass matrix in gauged N=4 supergravity

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional gauged N=4 supergravity with six vector multiplets and semisimple gauge groups admit positive-potential extrema stable against fluctuations of every scalar, including directions excluded by earlier truncations?

sources.title: On de Sitter vacua in strongly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative effects in heterotic M-theory produce four-dimensional de Sitter vacua with spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking while stabilizing the orbifold-length dilaton?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: How does the gravitino mass enter a four-dimensional supergravity potential when supersymmetry is preserved or spontaneously broken? Positive F- and D-terms can compensate the negative gravitino contribution.

sources.title: The Wasteland of Random Supergravities

evidence.text: What fraction of de Sitter critical points in random four-dimensional N=1 supergravity are metastable, and how does this depend on the hierarchy between supersymmetric and supersymmetry-breaking masses?

sources.title: De Sitter in Extended Supergravity

evidence.text: Can the extended gauged supergravity models then known to admit de Sitter vacua be connected by supersymmetry truncations, and can those truncations remove tachyons to produce additional stable N=2 examples?
